data.body: [P2] Complete the branch-sensitive publication tests required by CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Every bot fixture has the report marker; fixtures with another marker are human comments. Removing `c.body?.startsWith(marker)` therefore leaves the assertions unchanged while permitting unrelated bot comments to be overwritten. The CLI failure test also fails the initial GET, never exercising a POST or PATCH failure. This prior validation finding remains partially unresolved. Return to the validation design under rule 9 and cover unrelated bot comments and write failures remaining advisory.
